Ava Chen: Quick idea — midweek happy hour + boardgame pairing? Thu or Fri night? :thinking_face:
Luca Moretti: Thu works better for me, Friday is squeezed with calls.
Maya Patel: Thu for me too. Where were you thinking?
Ava Chen: The Wharf Taproom at 6pm? Small private area, drinks + order snacks. Plan: 'game roulette' — people draw a slip to get paired with a game and a partner, so new folks meet others.
Noah Rivera: Love that. I can bring a few pocket games and GF snacks (pretzels + hummus).
Zara Kim: I can run a 15-min trivia warmup if folks want. I’ll bring a cheap buzzer. :star-struck:
Ethan Brooks: Count me in. Can someone drop a calendar invite? Prefer 6:15 so I can finish a call.
Ava Chen: Will create the invite now — putting start at 6:15. RSVP in the invite pls. @everyone 
Maya Patel: RSVP: Thu ✅. Also: any dietary restrictions I should note for ordering?
Noah Rivera: FYI office kitchen closes at 7pm — OpsBot set a note earlier so we don't get stuck ordering late.
OpsBot: Reminder: office kitchen closes at 19:00. Please finish food pickups before closing time.
Zara Kim: If people can't make in person, we can do a hybrid table with a Zoom camera and one card game that streams well (Codenames works ok).
Luca Moretti: Good call. I’ll volunteer to set up laptop + speaker.
Ava Chen: Awesome. Quick RSVP poll here — reply with one of: `Thu`, `Fri`, `Can't make`. I’ll finalize numbers tomorrow morning. :raised_hands:
Ethan Brooks: Thu
Maya Patel: Thu
Noah Rivera: Thu
Zara Kim: Thu
Luca Moretti: Thu
Ava Chen: Great — looks like Thu wins. Invite sent, location in calendar description. See you all there! :beers:
